sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Manoj Kumar Tripathi,Satya Narayan Gupta,Vinod Kumar Tirpathi,Y
Counsel for Opposite Party :- Durgvijay Singh,G.A.,Nasir Hussain
Hon'ble Dr. Gautam Chowdhary,J.
(In Re : Criminal Misc. Short Term Bail/ Parole Application No. 3 of 2025)
1.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and the learned counsel for the informant.

2. This short term bail has been filed on behalf of applicant-Praveen Sinha, who is in jail in Case Crime No. 119 of 2024, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B I.P.C., Police Station Kotwali,
District Meerut.
3. On the strength of the affidavit filed in support of the short term bail application, the applicant seeks short term bail to perform last rites of his mother who died on 28.04.2025.

It is submitted by Praveen Sinha vs State Of U.P. on 9 May, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169019613/
1 the learned counsel for the applicant that thirteenth day rites of the mother of applicant are to be observed on 13.05.2025.
4.

entities.text: Praveen Sinha vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. and learned counsel for the informant, although have opposed the prayer of short term bail, but there is no denial of the fact with regard to the death of mother of the applicant.

5. In that view of the matter, we deem it appropriate to enlarge the applicant-Praveen Sinha, on short term bail in Case Crime No. 119 of 2024, under Sections 420, 467, 468, 471, 120-B I.P.C.,
Police Station Kotwali, District Meerut, from 12.05.2025 to 18.05.2025, subject to following conditions:
(i) That the applicant shall observe peace and tranquility during the period of short term bail and shall not indulge in any unlawful activity.
(iii) That the applicant shall surrender before the concerned C.J.M. immediately after the short term bail comes to an end, i.e., on 19.05.2025 and shall be lodged back in jail.

6. This order be intimated to the C.J.M., Meerut through the Registrar (Compliance) High Court,
Allahabad for making proper arrangement.
7. The C.J.M. concerned shall submit its report/ certificate regarding compliance of the order of this Court by the date next.

8. Let a copy of this order be supplied to the learned counsel for the applicant on usual charges today itself.
9.
Short term bail application is, accordingly, allowed.

10. List the bail application on 21.05.2025 as fresh before appropriate Court.
Order Date :- 9.5.2025

.
